objective: Actual A receipt before actual B memory write, fresh-context A recovery
Actual independent initial receipt, direct no-conflict publication without needless QA/reception
One actual Odoo local module/configuration task after previous two gates pass
candidate_policy: Reference is first treatment; only change canonical roles/tools for demonstrated defect, at most two corrections without progress. Freeze revisions before evaluation. Holdout hidden until initial freeze.
models: Codex collaboration inherited model and effort, fork_turns=none for behavioral contexts, no overrides
ordered_barrier: Do not start B until A draft, genuine child receipt and public QA pass are complete and snapshotted. Resume A only after B public completion and its context termination.
positive_barrier: Initial receipt genuine and traced; no mutation injected. Fresh resume must check freshness and reuse it if still valid.
odoo_scope: Disposable local Odoo task with synthetic business data; no remote/client/production mutation. Actual ORM/runtime evidence and independent reception required; environment/design preparation may proceed before documentary gates, execution after they pass.
adoption: Critical failures block promotion; mechanical and semantic evidence separated; preserve all original outcomes and calibration. Full tests/build/install/push/CI/external memory for any delivery.
